source_text:
Title: Classic Cheeseburger on Brioche
Servings: 4

Ingredients (component | amount unit | name | prep_style | pantry food_id):
- Beef Patty | 400 g | beef ground beef |  | 000011
- Beef Patty | 0.5 tsp | Garlic Powder |  | 000643
- Beef Patty | 0.5 tsp | Ground Onion |  | 000644
- Beef Patty | 5 g | kosher salt |  | 000293
- Beef Patty | 0.5 tsp | ground black pepper |  | 000285
- Burger Assembly | 150 g | brioche |  | 000336
- Burger Assembly | 40 g | cheddar |  | 000193
- Burger Assembly | 20 g | lettuce |  | 000079
- Burger Assembly | 60 g | Roma tomatoes, chopped |  | IMP-6d4cd7
- Burger Assembly | 20 g | pickled cucumbers (dill pickles) |  | 000446
- Burger Assembly | 15 g | unsalted butter |  | 000212

Steps in order (component | phase | minutes | text):
1. Beef Patty | Prep |  | Divide the chilled ground beef into two equal 200g portions.
2. Burger Assembly | Prep |  | Slice the brioche buns horizontally and slice the Roma tomatoes into thin uniform rounds.
3. Beef Patty | Prep |  | Form each portion into a patty about 10cm in diameter, slightly wider than your brioche bun.
4. Burger Assembly | Prep |  | Rinse the lettuce leaves under cold water and pat them completely dry using a kitchen towel.
5. Beef Patty | Prep |  | Press a small dimple into the center of each patty with your thumb to prevent shrinking and bulging during cooking.
6. Burger Assembly | Cook |  | Spread softened butter onto the cut sides of the brioche bun halves.
7. Beef Patty | Prep |  | In a small bowl, whisk together the garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
8. Burger Assembly | Cook |  | Place the buns in a separate skillet over medium heat and toast for 1-2 minutes until golden and crisp.
9. Beef Patty | Prep |  | Season the exterior of both patties generously on both sides with the spice mixture.
10. Burger Assembly | Cook |  | During the final minute of cooking the patties, place cheddar slices on top and cover the pan to melt the cheese.
11. Beef Patty | Cook |  | Heat a cast-iron skillet over high heat. SAFETY: Wash your hands and all surfaces that contacted raw meat thoroughly with soap.
12. Burger Assembly | Serve |  | Lay the bottom toasted bun on a plate and place a piece of lettuce followed by the tomato slices.
13. Beef Patty | Cook |  | Place patties in the hot pan and sear for 4 minutes until a dark brown crust forms, then flip.
14. Burger Assembly | Serve |  | Carefully place the cheesed beef patty onto the tomatoes and top with the pickled cucumber slices.
15. Beef Patty | Serve |  | Remove the patties from the heat and let them rest for 2 minutes to allow the juices to redistribute.
16. Burger Assembly | Serve |  | Finish by placing the top bun over the pickles and serve immediately while hot.

Slice {i6} horizontally and slice {i9} into thin, even rounds.
Rinse {i8} under cold water and pat completely dry with a kitchen towel.
Spread {i11} onto the cut sides of the buns.
Toast the buns cut side down in a separate skillet over medium heat for 1–2 minutes.
Lay the bottom buns on plates and top with the lettuce, the tomato slices and the cheesed patties. Top with {i10} and finish with the top buns. Serve immediately while hot.
